game: Mario & Sonic at the Olympic Winter Games
project: Mario & Sonic at the Olympic Winter Games native PC build
approach: Static recompilation of the disc's own code on the player's PC; bring your own disc, no game files distributed.
notes: Reaches the title, save select and name entry. Known problem: the game's threads hand over to each other about a million times a second, so menus run unpaced. Tested on Windows 11 by playing into the first real scene; on the Linux mini PC through the menus. Nothing here says the game is playable to the end. Built with AI assistance (Claude).
